name: spatial-constellation-harness
description: Understand, steer, and review parallel coding work from one live map of tasks, dependencies, changes, and evidence.

scripts.test: npm run build && cargo test --manifest-path supervisor/Cargo.toml && node --test test/*.test.js
scripts.check: cargo fmt --manifest-path supervisor/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path supervisor/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && prettier --check src testing test package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format: cargo fmt --manifest-path supervisor/Cargo.toml && prettier --write src testing test package.json .prettierrc.json
